evidence: Unsupported and imagined domains emit typed capability gaps.
Route plans and host observations remain input claims rather than execution proof.
Natural-language meaning, artifact generation, evidence, authentication, enforcement, and lifecycle actions remain explicitly unproven.
Human settings cap permissions, network, mutability, source use, resources, privacy, reuse rights, and lifecycle scope.
Higher consequence classes require new consent tiers and never inherit planning authority.
Taste and meaning require a human seat and cannot be replaced by a machine verifier.
The planner reuses Fabric v2 route records, deterministic-json-core, Hand Specification Foundry, and existing consent-tier semantics.
All 21 Fabric selftest scripts and five direct organ-continuity scripts passed.
No Foundation, registry, executor, canonical checkout, or existing contract was replaced.
The rung stops at a deterministic program and never runs a candidate or provider.
Domain-native evidence remains UNKNOWN and NOT_RUN until its own proof surface is used.
Self-consistent re-digested contradictions fail standalone record validation.

limitations: This gate covers only the v0.8 pure planning contract and tests.
It does not establish universal creation capability or semantic understanding.
Passing tests are not integration, promotion, publication, physical authorization, or CANON.
